abstract: Primary immature mediastinal teratoma is very rare. The prognosis of this tumour observed in the late teens or adulthood was thought to be very poor. However, recent advances in chemotherapy have improved the prognosis. Eleven patients > 15 years of age with immature mediastinal teratoma (two of our patients and nine from the literature) were reviewed. These patients were classified into survivor and non-survivor groups, and the characteristics in each group were evaluated. In the survivor group, the tumour was completely resected in all patients. In addition, patients showing a high level of alpha-fetoprotein were treated by pre-operative chemotherapy, and those who were pre-operatively negative for tumour markers were treated by post-operative chemotherapy and survived for a long period. All patients in whom the tumour was resected incompletely, or where no chemotherapy was performed, were included in the non-survivor group. In patients > 15 years of age with immature mediastinal teratoma, complete surgical resection of the tumour is indispensable. When complete resection is combined with chemotherapy, long survival can be expected. Conversely, unless both treatment methods are performed, the outcome is very poor.
abstract_ja: 15歳以上の原発性未熟縦隔奇形腫の患者11例(自験例2例、文献からの9例)をレビューした。これらの患者を生存群と非生存群に分類し、各群の特徴を評価した。生存群では、全例で腫瘍が完全に切除されていた。さらに、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)高値の患者には術前化学療法が行われ、術前に腫瘍マーカーが陰性であった患者には術後化学療法が行われ、長期間生存した。腫瘍が不完全に切除された患者、または化学療法が行われなかった患者は、すべて非生存群に含めた。15歳以上の未熟縦隔奇形腫の患者では、腫瘍の完全な外科的切除が不可欠である。完全切除と化学療法を併用すると、長期生存が期待できる。逆に、両方の治療が行われない場合、予後は非常に不良である。
